mentions.name: fxdax
mentions.description: A port of Fuchsia's fxfs to Linux, built on a novel virtio device that stores file data in object storage. Intended as a file system for VMs that supports DAX to avoid page cache duplication while maintaining high performance.
mentions.problem: Page cache duplication when VMs access file data; DAX support avoids this duplication while maintaining high performance.

fxdax - https://github.com/semistrict/fxdax a port of fuschia fxfs to linux on top of a novel virtio device that stores file

maintaining high performance
